Event: Varworth summit. Host: Lorcan Vardale. Budget: 41,000. Venue: Morton Hall.
Staffing: Teo out; Mira covers. Una, Greta, Ada, Kira out. Ada out for rest of week; Rafe covers. Pia, Opal, Finn, Bram, Dell, Esme, Ines, Wren, Leon, Suri, Cora, Nils, Jonah, Hugo, Vik covering. Jonah out for rest of week; Finn covers. Swap list: Jonah/Dell, Una/Finn, Ines/Vik, Opal/Hugo, Nils/Rafe, Cora/Suri, Esme/Teo. Ines/Teo swapping desks this week.
Logistics: Lift near library annex is slow. Lift near garden studio is slow. Print room: evening noise, repainted, afternoon noise, umbrella, coffee machine working. Loading bay: evening noise, coffee machine, free afternoon, repainted, umbrella, evening stand-up moved here. East wing: coffee machine, morning stand-up moved here, too cold afternoon/evening, repainted, afternoon noise, slow lift. North office: free morning, repainted, morning noise, umbrella left, coffee machine working. Garden studio: coffee machine, afternoon stand-up. Umbrellas in north office, loading bay, east wing, garden studio, print room, library annex. Library annex: repainting, afternoon noise, evening noise, umbrella left, evening stand-up moved here.
Preferences: Pia, Kira, Hugo want harbour room clear. Rafe wants print room clear. Ines wants library annex clear. Esme/Finn prefer loading bay. Bram/Leon prefer garden studio. Hugo prefers loading bay. Ada prefers garden studio for reviews. Kira prefers garden studio for reviews. Leon thinks print room too cold morning. Suri thinks garden studio too cold evening. Una thinks library annex too cold evening. Kira thinks print room too cold afternoon. Kira wants print room kept clear for visitors. Mira wants loading bay kept clear for visitors. Dell prefers library annex for reviews.
Actions: Send notes to Una, Wren, Dell (morning); Opal, Mira, Teo (afternoon); Cora, Ada, Pia, Opal (evening). Check Mira before evening meeting. Remind about Finn, Bram, Hugo, Leon, Ada preferences. Leon asked if library annex free afternoon. Send Leon evening meeting notes. Send Ines afternoon meeting notes. Send Suri morning meeting notes. Nils asked if garden studio free evening. Send Teo morning meeting notes.
